Music (VLM) with Spotify and other apps.

- New in Music: Play along with another app. Start your music in Spotify (or YouTube Music, a radio app, anything), then pick this, and VLM follows it. Spotify keeps playing the music; NUONDroid just listens.
- R1 / L1 (and Next track in the menu) skip tracks in Spotify, like headphone buttons.
- If Spotify is installed, there's an Open Spotify shortcut on the Music screen.
- Android asks for the microphone permission (it puts hearing other apps under that; nothing is recorded from the microphone) and for screen capture, which is how Android lets an app hear other apps in full quality. Only the sound is used.
- If you decline screen capture, or the app blocks it (Spotify may), NUONDroid switches to Android's Visualizer by itself. The beats still come through, a little coarser.
- Not tested on a device yet. If the screen says "No music yet" while Spotify is playing, tell me.
